name: graphflow
description: Token-First Surgical Code Engine for AI Coding Agents: true AST for TypeScript/JS plus structural analyzers for Python, Go, Rust, C/C++, C#; receiver-type-aware Blast Radius, safe rename, real best-effort knowledge-graph edges, tsconfig-alias-aware affected tests, Output Dehydrator (98.7% fewer test-log tokens on the repo suite), Git Co-Change Miner & Habit Macros.

graphflow.autoInstall.description: Automatically register GraphFlow MCP, Skills & Hooks to detected agents on install/update (once per version). Set to false for manual-only registration via the 'GraphFlow: Install MCP, Skills & Hooks to Agents' command.
